name: mahjong
description: Node dependencies for the JS/CSS build (Dockerfile: jsbuild). devDependencies are Tailwind's CSS build (assets/tailwind.src.css — deliberately outside static/, see its own header comment: a documented WhiteNoise+Tailwind gotcha, not a one-off workaround) — the one thing here that genuinely needs npm-style module resolution (@import "tailwindcss"), unlike esbuild/Biome which run fine via bare npx. dependencies DO ship client-side: @dicebear/* is imported by static/game/avatar.js and gets bundled into static/game/bundle.js by esbuild (which also runs via npm ci, not bare npx, for the same node_modules access).
